name: The Lost One
description: The first step taken without certainty. A soul unmarked by consequence, standing at the edge of fate.

name: The Occultist
description: Knowledge claimed and power shaped by intent.

name: The Veiled
description: Truth sensed, not spoken.

name: The Matron of Thorns
description: Growth that understands pain.

name: The Crimson Crown
description: Rule paid for in blood.

name: The Heretic
description: Faith questioned and enforced.

name: The Binding
description: Oaths willingly sealed.

name: The Pale Steed
description: Victory through endurance.

name: The Hunger Within
description: The beast mastered, not slain.

name: The Lantern Bearer
description: Light carried through darkness.

name: The Turning
description: Change without mercy.

name: The Severed Scales
description: Balance stained by truth.

name: The Suspended
description: Insight through stillness.

name: The Veil
description: Passage without return.

name: The Elixir
description: Alchemy of survival.

name: The Pact
description: Chains worn willingly.

name: The Fall
description: Collapse of lies.

name: The Last Light
description: Faith after ruin.

name: The Blood Moon
description: Truth distorted by shadow.

name: The Awakening
description: Truth without shadow.

name: The Reckoning
description: The past answered.

name: The Threshold
description: Arrival transformed.

name: Ace of Ashes
upright: The spark of inspiration, raw potential, a new drive or calling.
reversed: Burnout, false starts, lack of direction.
description: A single flame lit among the graves. Everything begins as a spark that does not yet know what it will burn.

name: Two of Ashes
upright: Choosing a direction, focused ambition, weighing future paths.
reversed: Indecision, fear of commitment, scattered will.
description: A plan read by torchlight over a sleeping city. Every road is weighed before one is taken.

name: Three of Ashes
upright: Expansion, momentum, plans set into motion.
description: A pale ship leaves harbor under torn sails. Ambition set in motion, with something watching from the hull.

name: Four of Ashes
upright: Stability through control, maintaining what has been built.
description: A hall that should have fallen, held standing by tall flames. What fire built is guarded closely.

name: Five of Ashes
upright: Conflict of wills, competition, creative tension.
reversed: Avoidance of struggle, suppressed drive, unresolved rivalry.
description: Torches raised in a crowd that cannot agree. Every will insists on its own light.

name: Six of Ashes
reversed: Hollow victory, arrogance, success without fulfillment.
description: A pale rider returns with fire at his brow. The victory is earned, and the crowd knows it.

name: Seven of Ashes
upright: Defending one's position, standing firm against pressure.
reversed: Giving up ground, exhaustion, lack of resolve.
description: One figure on the stairs, torch lifted against whatever climbs toward her. High ground is held by refusing to step back.

name: Eight of Ashes
upright: Swift movement, decisive action, momentum accelerating.
reversed: Rash decisions, misdirected energy, loss of control.
description: Three burning arrows loosed into smoke. Once the will is released, there is no calling it back.

name: Nine of Ashes
description: A weary watcher among a field of torches, still holding one. Endurance past the point of comfort.

name: Ten of Ashes
upright: Overextension, burden of ambition, collapse from excess.
reversed: Release of responsibility, recovery, rebuilding from ruin.
description: A skeleton bent beneath ten torches it cannot set down. Ambition becomes a weight carried until it breaks the one who bears it.

name: Acolyte of Ashes
description: A young seeker guards a small flame in a lantern. Eager, unmarked, and not yet afraid of what fire can do.

name: Wanderer of Ashes
upright: Relentless pursuit, bold action, chasing inspiration.
description: Coat flying, lantern swinging, running toward something only they can see. Pursuit without a map.

name: Lady of Ashes
reversed: Intimidation, suppressed desire, misuse of influence.
description: She sits among shadows with her torch steady, skull-faced and unafraid. Authority that has already made peace with what it will burn.

name: Lord of Ashes
upright: Visionary leadership, command of purpose, disciplined ambition.
reversed: Tyranny, burnout-driven control, ambition without conscience.
description: He stands in the ruins with the torch held like a scepter. Command over fire, earned by knowing what it consumes.

name: Ace of Vessels
upright: The beginning of emotional awareness, a new feeling, bond, or intuitive opening.
reversed: Emotional blockage, withheld affection, or fear of vulnerability.
description: Smoke rises from the cup in the shape of faces. A new feeling arrives carrying every old one with it.

name: Two of Vessels
upright: Mutual connection, emotional alignment, shared understanding.
reversed: Imbalance, miscommunication, or unequal emotional investment.
description: Two cups face each other, and what pours from one has already reached the other. Understanding that runs both ways.

name: Three of Vessels
description: One cup pours itself into another. Joy is only kept by being shared.

name: Four of Vessels
description: Three cups stand ready while a fourth lies fallen. Withdrawn from what is offered, and watching it from far away.

name: Five of Vessels
upright: Loss, grief, regret, focus on what has been lost.
description: Three cups spilled and two still standing. Grief looks only at what is lost.

name: Six of Vessels
upright: Memory, nostalgia, past connections influencing the present.
reversed: Being trapped in the past, refusal to grow beyond memory.
description: A pale figure watches from the green dark over cups kept like relics. The past is not gone, only waiting beside the present.

name: Seven of Vessels
description: Each cup holds a different phantom: a crown, a face, a serpent, a flame. Not every vision is worth reaching for.

name: Eight of Vessels
upright: Emotional departure, walking away, seeking deeper meaning.
reversed: Avoidance, fear of leaving, emotional stagnation.
description: Eight cups left standing in a drowned ruin, with no one to claim them. The search for something deeper begins by leaving.

name: Nine of Vessels
reversed: Hollow contentment, indulgence, unmet deeper needs.
description: Nine full cups lined along an altar, candles burning low. A quiet satisfaction, enough for tonight.

name: Ten of Vessels
upright: Emotional completion, lasting bonds, shared fulfillment.
reversed: Emotional overload, fractured harmony, unrealistic expectations.
description: Ten cups ringed around a sealed circle, roses among the bones. What is bound here is bound for good.

name: Acolyte of Vessels
description: A hooded novice leans toward a glowing cup as if it might speak. Sensitive, open, and easily moved.

name: Wanderer of Vessels
upright: Romantic pursuit, emotional idealism, following the heart.
description: Under a red moon, a traveler carries her cup toward someone she has only imagined. Devotion that walks before it knows the way.

name: Lady of Vessels
description: She sits beside still water with the cup held close in her lap. She feels everything and is not undone by it.

name: Lord of Vessels
upright: Emotional authority, stability, stewardship of relationships.
reversed: Emotional manipulation, detachment, imbalance of feeling.
description: A crowned skeleton holds his cup steady under a red moon. He has outlasted every storm of feeling and keeps watch over those still inside them.

name: Ace of Thorns
upright: Mental clarity, truth revealed, decisive thought.
reversed: Confusion, denial, truth obscured or rejected.
description: A blade rises from the dark, still wet from the first cut. Truth does not knock. It enters.

name: Two of Thorns
description: She sits with two thorns crossed over her heart, her eyes lost in the hood. Nothing gets in. Nothing gets out.

name: Three of Thorns
reversed: Healing from grief, release of sorrow.
description: Three thorns through a heart, pinned to the letter that broke it. Some truths are written. Others are driven home.

name: Four of Thorns
reversed: Restlessness, refusal to pause, mental strain.
description: She lies in the chapel like an effigy, one flame still burning in her hand. Not dead, only resting, until the mind can bear to wake.

name: Five of Thorns
description: He stands over the fallen with the thorn still in his fist while the house burns behind him. He won. Look what it cost.

name: Six of Thorns
upright: Mental transition, moving on from conflict.
reversed: Inability to leave the past, clinging to wounds.
description: The ferryman poles across black water, his thorns laid down behind him. Whatever happened on that shore, he is not going back for it.

name: Seven of Thorns
description: A grinning thief flees the burning chapel, arms full of stolen blades. The cleverest wars are won before anyone knows they started.

name: Eight of Thorns
reversed: Release, clarity, breaking free from constraint.
description: Blindfolded, bound, and ringed by thorns that never touch her. The cage holds only as long as she believes it does.

name: Nine of Thorns
reversed: Relief, acceptance, easing of inner fear.
description: She wakes at the hour when every thorn above her bed looks like a verdict. Guilt keeps late hours.

name: Ten of Thorns
description: Ten thorns through a body on the altar stone, roses scattered like an afterthought. It is finished. There is nothing left to betray.

name: Acolyte of Thorns
description: A pale student turns a rose in bandaged fingers, studying exactly where it bites. Every question is a small blade.

name: Wanderer of Thorns
upright: Direct action, confrontation, pursuit of truth.
description: He tears through the dark with a thorn branch raised like a sword. He has found the truth and means to deliver it, ready or not.

name: Lady of Thorns
description: She wears her crown over a bare skull and holds a rose she has no intention of smelling. Nothing is hidden from her, and she will tell you so.

name: Lord of Thorns
reversed: Tyranny, abuse of logic, domination through fear.
description: Crowned in thorns, he sits upright on a throne grown from them. Every word he speaks has been weighed, sharpened, and placed.

name: Ace of Coins
upright: New opportunity, material stability beginning, a solid foundation.
description: A hand reaches up out of the dark toward a single gold coin. It is small, but it is real, and it can be built on.

name: Two of Coins
description: A hooded skeleton keeps two coins turning in the air above one open palm. Nothing falls, so long as the hand stays steady.

name: Three of Coins
reversed: Poor teamwork, lack of recognition, flawed work.
description: Three coins set into the cathedral stone, each carved by a different hand: a tree, a skull, a door. The work outlasts the workers.

name: Four of Coins
reversed: Greed, fear of loss, refusal to let go.
description: A skeleton on its throne holds four coins against its ribs. What is kept is safe, and it is kept very close.

name: Five of Coins
upright: Hardship, scarcity, exclusion, survival under strain.
description: Two beggars kneel in the dirt below a chapel window, gathering what was dropped. Survival happens on the ground, and it is never quite enough.

name: Six of Coins
upright: Giving and receiving, fairness, material balance.
description: A tall man in black presses a coin into a ghostly hand while others wait their turn. What is given here is measured, and every hand is counted.

name: Seven of Coins
upright: Patience, long-term investment, waiting for results.
reversed: Impatience, wasted effort, doubt in progress.
description: A hooded gardener leans on his staff before a tree that grows coins instead of leaves. The harvest is coming. It will not be hurried.

name: Eight of Coins
description: By one candle, a hooded smith strikes coin after coin. Mastery is the same blow, repeated until it is right.

name: Nine of Coins
reversed: Isolation, false security, dependence on status.
description: She walks her own orchard alone, gold ripening in the branches around her. Everything here, she grew herself.

name: Ten of Coins
reversed: Instability, broken inheritance, loss of foundation.
description: An old man sits beneath an arch of coins, his ancestors gathered behind the throne. What is built well is handed down, and the dead keep watch over it.

name: Acolyte of Coins
description: A young novice holds a coin up to the light in the crypt, turning it slowly. She learns at her own pace, and she learns it properly.

name: Wanderer of Coins
description: A hooded rider carries a single coin through the dark woods at a walk. He is never fast, but he always arrives.

name: Lady of Coins
upright: Nurturing stability, care through action, grounded wisdom.
description: She lays a coin in the cradle by moonlight. Here, love looks like provision.

name: Lord of Coins
reversed: Greed, rigidity, valuing control over care.
description: Crowned and still, he holds a single coin as if weighing a kingdom. Everything in his care is counted, and everything counted is cared for.
